cases.name: bytecode-the-type-gate-runs-on-the-source
cases.source:
print("this line must never run")
# Built-ins with known signatures are checked like any typed function.
let n: int = 5
print(upper(n))       # T002
print(sqrt("nine"))   # T002
print(len())          # T003
print(pad("x", 2.5))  # T002
let count: int = len("abc")
let root: int = sqrt(16)  # T006: sqrt gives a float
let whole: int = floor(2.7)
let back: int = abs(-3)  # abs keeps an int an int
print(count, whole, back, split("a b"), split("a,b", ","))
cases.error:
TypeCheckError: T002 argument 1 of upper() must be a string, but this is an int
  also line 5: T002 argument 1 of sqrt() must be a float, but this is a string
  also line 6: T003 len() takes 1 argument but is given 0
  also line 7: T002 argument 2 of pad() must be an int, but this is a float
  also line 9: T006 'root' is declared int, but its value is a float
